verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents feature flags with runtime evaluation, release conditions and remote config. Nothing describes server SDKs evaluating flags locally from a cached ruleset, or flag checks that avoid a network call. The generic 'evaluate flags at runtime' line does not show local evaluation, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check
